name: Uther names the taint

date.label: Wrath of the Lich King, patch 3.3.5 quest sequence; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Uther’s spirit speaks beside the chamber’s blade: saronite is the blood of an Old God, and the ore has tainted what the hammer restored. His counsel turns the quest toward the Sunwell. No forging technique can cleanse this wound. Beyond the frozen halls lies a place of older light, reclaimed by the blood elves after its earlier fall. There, the sword’s makers’ legacy may be tested against the darkness forced into it.
